name: Castellet i la Gornal (Spain)
description: Blue field with a closed castle centred at 4/9 of the length from the hoist, drawn in yellow in this version.
history: The official flag of Castellet i la Gornal is an oblong flag of 2:3, blue, with a closed castle in black centred at the end of the 4/9 of the cloth counted from the hoist, 5/12 of the length wide and 7/9 of the height; this rendering shows the castle in gold.

features.role: closed castle, 5/12 of the length wide and 7/9 of the height, centred at 4/9 from the hoist
